aly@[something] ObjectThis is the method responsible for indexing AppFunctions (where we can see our custom AppFunctions being rejected). Gets called somehow, somewhere.
It essentially has a populated map of AppFunctionMetadata triples, and tries to retrieve the indexed function against this schema. If it fails - Gemini does not index this AppFunction at all.

div.div:
Following invocation of aruz, there's an Object objM12956a = arveVar.f46717c.m12956a(executeAppFunctionRequest, this)
The property f46717c is an arve property, passed via constructor, of type arup. Then aruz calls
arve.f46717c
Then arup.m12956a delegates to aeiVar.m3871a(),
aeivar is from this.f46665b, which is from
aeg.m3836a(context) and this method itself returns the
AppFunctionManager, needed for the AppFunction call
